about_the_game:
On an isolated island shrouded in fog, an archaeologist is tasked with understanding more about the archipelago's past. In this first-person game, immerse yourself in an experience filled with psychological horror and face your survival instincts.

The silence here is as deafening as the crashing waves of the ocean. As the player explores the island, they will be guided by a growing sense of unease, with a constant feeling that something is watching, always one step ahead, always observing.

With each discovery, the player will feel the weight of mounting tension. The fear here doesn't come from monsters leaping out of the shadows, but from the gradual realization that the island is more alive than it seems.

Mysterious sounds, flickering lights, and glimpses of figures will make the player question what is real. Prepare to face solitude, the unknown, and an ever-present sense of danger. The island holds secrets, but be warned: sometimes, silence is the best answer.

short_description: On a remote and forgotten island, a century-old lighthouse that once guided ships across the seven seas has ceased to function. Its disappearance has sparked countless theories and speculations. To solve the mystery, the protagonist, is hired to investigate The Lighthouse Secrets.
